softRemoved.description:
Whether or not object has been marked removed. Note that using "removed" as the attribute instead will cause a
C3 package error, as it will override an existing method

projects.description: The {@link Genai.Project} this instance is linked to.

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

parentResult.description: The initial {@link Genai.Query.Result} of the conversation.

chatMessages.description: Follow up chat queries associated with the original #parentResult.

queryResults.description: Foreign key to the {@link Genai.Query.Result}s in this conversation.

lastUpdated.description: The timestamp of the last query from the conversation.

title:
Represents a conversation a user has initiated in the app.
A conversation is comprised of a parent query and any follow up chats.
name: Genai.Conversation
